title: Three women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember three women from Veneto, Lombardy and Basilicata. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold them in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Carlina Besaggio
tribute: Carlina Besaggio was 71 years old and lived in Casale di Scodosia, in the province of Padua. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Calvatone
tribute: She was 74 years old and lived in Calvatone, in the province of Cremona. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Grassano
tribute: She was 72 years old and came from Grassano, in the province of Matera. She is in our thoughts.
